entry.description: Write characters the encoding cannot represent as `\uXXXX` in `FileAppender`, `RollingFileAppender`, `UdpAppender` and both `SmtpAppender` classes. They used to become `?`, U+FFFD or a look-alike character. On .NET Framework the default encoding is the ANSI code page, so text outside it, such as Cyrillic or Chinese, now shows as escapes unless you set `utf-8` (ANT-2026-3WK17LYB, fixed by @FreeAndNil in https://github.com/apache/logging-log4net/pull/355[#355])
